name: smwgraphics-zelda-themed-enemies
title: Zelda-Themed Enemies
description:
This EXGFX replaces a few things with those of the Zelda series.
Shell-less Koopa - ChuChu
Koopa - Deku Scrub
Goomba - Octorok
It is recommended that you use the SMB3 Koopa patch, unless you think Deku Scrubs spawning ChuChus is normal! Requires a custom palette.
